items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: That was the first, I guess, real professional band I'd ever played with. ... Tony made a couple of them parades with us

ctx.x: Oh, you were talking about Tony Giardino? Now, who started with Tony? He did.
Hal started playing with Tony Giardino, he was really young. I guess you must have been about 14, 15, isn't he?
When I was in Peter's high school at him, like 1940, 1941, before I graduated from high school. Played at Feynman's Hall in West Wigo.
